company_expenses_paid_audit_valid.name: company_expenses_paid_audit_valid
company_expenses_paid_audit_valid.value: ("company_expenses"."reimbursement_status" = 'unpaid' and "company_expenses"."paid_at" is null and "company_expenses"."paid_by_user_id" is null) or ("company_expenses"."reimbursement_status" = 'paid' and "company_expenses"."paid_at" is not null and "company_expenses"."paid_by_user_id" is not null)

litho_pricing_profiles_active_session_id.name: litho_pricing_profiles_active_session_id_set_unique
litho_pricing_profiles_active_session_id.where: "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."active" = true and "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."archived_at" is null and "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."session_id" is not null

litho_pricing_profiles_active_number_com.name: litho_pricing_profiles_active_number_compat_set_unique
litho_pricing_profiles_active_number_com.where: "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."active" = true and "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."archived_at" is null and "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."session_id" is null and "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."session_number" is not null

litho_pricing_profiles_active_legacy_set.name: litho_pricing_profiles_active_legacy_set_unique
litho_pricing_profiles_active_legacy_set.where: "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."active" = true and "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."archived_at" is null and "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."session_number" is null

litho_pricing_profiles_active_session_id.name: litho_pricing_profiles_active_session_id_base_unique

litho_pricing_profiles_active_number_com.name: litho_pricing_profiles_active_number_compat_base_unique
litho_pricing_profiles_active_number_com.where: "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."active" = true and "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."archived_at" is null and "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."is_base" = true and "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."session_id" is null and "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."session_number" is not null

litho_pricing_profiles_active_legacy_bas.name: litho_pricing_profiles_active_legacy_base_unique
litho_pricing_profiles_active_legacy_bas.where: "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."active" = true and "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."archived_at" is null and "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."is_base" = true and "lithotripsy_pricing_profiles"."session_number" is null

operation_financial_item_kind_amount.name: operation_financial_item_kind_amount
operation_financial_item_kind_amount.value: ("operation_financial_items"."kind" = 'note' and "operation_financial_items"."amount" is null and "operation_financial_items"."financial_effect" = 'neutral') or ("operation_financial_items"."kind" = 'financial' and "operation_financial_items"."amount" >= 0)

operation_financial_item_adjustment_cons.name: operation_financial_item_adjustment_consistent
operation_financial_item_adjustment_cons.value: "operation_financial_items"."base_amount" is null or "operation_financial_items"."adjustment_amount" is null or "operation_financial_items"."effective_amount" = "operation_financial_items"."base_amount" + "operation_financial_items"."adjustment_amount"

service_pricing_profiles_scope_check.name: service_pricing_profiles_scope_check
service_pricing_profiles_scope_check.value: ("service_pricing_profiles"."operation_type" = 'contract' and "service_pricing_profiles"."hospital_id" is not null) or ("service_pricing_profiles"."operation_type" = 'endoscopy' and "service_pricing_profiles"."hospital_id" is null)

work_form_fields_selection_bounds.name: work_form_fields_selection_bounds
work_form_fields_selection_bounds.value: ("work_form_fields"."min_selections" is null or "work_form_fields"."min_selections" >= 0) and ("work_form_fields"."max_selections" is null or "work_form_fields"."max_selections" >= coalesce("work_form_fields"."min_selections", 0))

work_form_fields_financial_effect_check.name: work_form_fields_financial_effect_check
work_form_fields_financial_effect_check.value: ("work_form_fields"."is_financial" and "work_form_fields"."financial_effect" is not null) or (not "work_form_fields"."is_financial" and "work_form_fields"."financial_effect" is null)
